suppress.notes: False positive: CVE-2020-29582 affects kotlin.io.path.createTempFile default permissions. kotlin-stdlib-common is a transitive dependency from the Anthropic Java SDK — this project does not use Kotlin APIs or create temp files via Kotlin.

CVE-2026-53914: unsafe deserialization of Kotlin BUILD CACHE metadata (KAPT / the Gradle build cache). Dependency-Check maps every org.jetbrains.kotlin:* coordinate onto the single CPE cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin:*, so the runtime stdlib is flagged for a build-toolchain defect. This is a Maven project: no .kt sources, no Gradle files, no kotlin-maven-plugin and no build cache. Kotlin is here only as a transitive runtime library of the Anthropic Java SDK.
Note the score the gate reads is not the vendor's. JetBrains, as the CNA, scores this 6.7 (AV:L/AC:H/PR:H — local, high complexity, high privilege); the 9.8 failing the build is NVD's automated worst-case vector.
Scoped to stdlib and reflect because kotlin-stdlib-jdk7/jdk8 and kotlin-reflect all match the same CPE. Secondary fact, not the argument: no fixed release is installable — kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 is unpublished (Central 404; latest is 2.4.20-Beta2), and 2.4.0 and 2.4.10 both sit inside the affected range. Revisit on Kotlin 2.4.20 GA.

CVE-2026-66299: an unbounded undelivered-message buffer in the Tomcat WebSocket CHAT EXAMPLE application. That code ships in the `examples` webapp of the full Tomcat distribution and is not present in the tomcat-embed-* jars at all — an embedded Spring Boot application deploys no webapps. GHSA-rpf9-hrjr-88fv lists "No package listed" and gives "remove the examples web application" as the mitigation, which is a no-op here.
Independently of that, this application declares no WebSocket endpoints: no @ServerEndpoint, no STOMP and no SockJS anywhere in backend/src.
Apache rates it Low; the 7.5 that trips the gate is CISA-ADP enrichment. Secondary fact, not the argument: the fix is Tomcat 11.0.25, which is marked "not yet released" and 404s on Maven Central. When it is published, delete this block and raise tomcat.version — do not renew it.
